title: Show HN: Mini-AGI – Dynamic continual learning model trained on 8GB VRAM
summary: A Show HN project presenting Mini-AGI, a continual learning model trainable on 8GB VRAM. It combines a dynamically growing/pruning Mixture-of-Experts architecture with batch-1 training on a continuous 32K-character data stream, allowing training without large randomized batches. The author used Claude to help develop the approach and is training on a 7.8B-character corpus, with scaling law graphs and sample outputs shared.
